Here we conduct power simulations for the registered experiment.

## Preparation

### Packages

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# Packages
library(MPTinR)
library(tidyverse)
```

### MPT model specification

```{r}
mpt_model <- "
# Baseline tree
d1+(1-d1)*p
(1-d1)*(1-p)
# CP tree
d2+(1-d2)*p
(1-d2)*(1-p)
"
```

## Simulation-based power analysis

### Parameters

```{r}
d_1 <- 0.397  # Baseline d
d_2 <- 0.316  # CP d
p_match <- 0.2  # Probability of actually obtaining a match
iterations <- 5000
min_n <- 700
max_n <- 1500
n_step <- 50

baseline_constraint <- list("p = 0.2")
restricted_constraint <- list("p = 0.2", "d1 = d2")
```

### Simulation

```{r}
ns <- seq(from = min_n, to = max_n, by = n_step)
powers <- c()

set.seed(2026)

for (n in ns) {
  sig_results <- c()
  
  for (i in 1:iterations) {
    
    # Generate random data
    dat <- gen.data(
      parameter.values = c(d1 = d_1, d2 = d_2, p = p_match),
      samples = 1,
      model.filename = textConnection(mpt_model),
      n.per.item.type = c(n, n)
    )
    dat <- as.vector(dat)
    
    # Fit saturated model
    mod_baseline <- fit.model(
      data = dat,
      model.filename = textConnection(mpt_model),
      restrictions.filename = baseline_constraint,
      output = "full",
      show.messages = FALSE
    )
    
    # Fit model with constraint d1 = d2
    mod_restricted <- fit.model(
      data = dat,
      model.filename = textConnection(mpt_model),
      restrictions.filename = restricted_constraint,
      output = "full",
      show.messages = FALSE
    )
    
    # Model comparison, retrieve p-value
    mod_comp <- select.mpt(list(mod_baseline, mod_restricted), output = "full")
    p_value <- mod_comp$p[2]
    sig_results[i] <- (p_value < .05)
  }
  
  # Compute power at sample size n
  powers[match(n, ns)] <- mean(sig_results)
}
```

### Simulation results

```{r}
as.data.frame(cbind(ns, powers)) %>% print(max_n = length(ns))
```

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Show the code"
ggplot(as.data.frame(cbind(ns, powers)), aes(x = ns, y = powers)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE, method = "loess") +
  labs(
    title = "Simulation results",
    subtitle = "Based on observed parameter values from the pilot study",
    x = "Sample size per condition",
    y = "Statistical power"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min_n, max_n, by = 50)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0.6, 1, by = 0.05)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.80, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank()
  )
```

## Simulation-based sensitivity analysis

### Parameters

```{r}
d_1 <- 0.397  # Baseline d
d_2_min <- 0.27
d_2_max <- 0.33
d_step <- 0.005
iterations <- 5000
p_match <- 0.2  # Probability of actually obtaining a match
n_per_condition <- 1000

baseline_constraint <- list("p = 0.2")
restricted_constraint <- list("p = 0.2", "d1 = d2")
```

### Simulation

```{r}
d_2s <- seq(from = d_2_min, to = d_2_max, by = d_step)
powers <- c()

set.seed(2026)

for (d_2 in d_2s) {
  sig_results <- c()
  
  for (i in 1:iterations) {
    
    # Generate random data
    dat <- gen.data(
      parameter.values = c(d1 = d_1, d2 = d_2, p = p_match),
      samples = 1,
      model.filename = textConnection(mpt_model),
      n.per.item.type = c(n_per_condition, n_per_condition)
    )
    dat <- as.vector(dat)
    
    # Fit saturated model
    mod_baseline <- fit.model(
      data = dat,
      model.filename = textConnection(mpt_model),
      restrictions.filename = baseline_constraint,
      output = "full",
      show.messages = FALSE
    )
    
    # Fit model with constraint d1 = d2
    mod_restricted <- fit.model(
      data = dat,
      model.filename = textConnection(mpt_model),
      restrictions.filename = restricted_constraint,
      output = "full",
      show.messages = FALSE
    )
    
    # Model comparison, retrieve p-value
    mod_comp <- select.mpt(list(mod_baseline, mod_restricted), output = "full")
    p_value <- mod_comp$p[2]
    sig_results[i] <- (p_value < .05)
  }
  
  # Compute power at sample size n
  powers[match(d_2, d_2s)] <- mean(sig_results)
}
```

### Simulation results

```{r}
as.data.frame(cbind(d_2s, powers)) %>% print(max_n = length(d_2s))
```

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Show the code"
ggplot(as.data.frame(cbind(d_2s, powers)), aes(x = d_2s, y = powers)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE, method = "loess") +
  labs(
    title = "Simulation results",
    subtitle = expression(paste(
      "Based on ",
      italic("n"),
      " = 1,000 per condition and the observed d = .397 in Baseline"
    )),
    x = "True d in CP",
    y = "Statistical power"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(d_2_min, d_2_max, by = 0.01)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0.4, 1, by = 0.05)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.80, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank()
  )
```
